How contextual explanations work

Readers infer meaning from the concepts immediately surrounding an unfamiliar phrase.

A language model can build a contextual representation by considering a phrase together with its sentence, section, and document subject.

The useful context is local prose, not every item that happens to appear nearby in the document tree.
